{{Quote|To galactic south, the Neo-Crusaders left Eres in ruins, raided Azure and Contruum, and linked up with Mandalorian units at Dxun.|From Vilnau Teupt's "Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul", 24 ABY|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
A '''battle''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]]<ref name="Warfare" /> took place as part of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]], in [[3962 BBY]]. It occurred during a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] campaign to capture of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. [[Mandalorian Triumph]], as the charge was called, brought the Mandalorian forces from their territory [[Battle of Azure|through]]<ref name="Atlas" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Azure/Legends|Azure]].<ref name="Warfare" /> After Azure, they won the battle on Contruum and moved on to [[Battle of the Gizer system (Mandalorian Wars)|take]] the [[Gizer system/Legends|Gizer system]], proceeding further Coreward.<ref name="Atlas" />

In the [[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul|keynote address]] at the four-hundred-twelfth [[Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History]], in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], [[Vilnau Teupt]] spoke of the Mandalorian race's development, dwelling on the Mandalorian Wars and talking on Mandalorian Triumph, mentioning the sacking of Contruum.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was referenced once in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], in which the [[Contruum system/Legends|Contruum system]] was marked on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map showing [[Star system/Legends|systems]] that hosted battles of the Mandalorian Wars.<ref name="Atlas" />
